excerpts.content:
New [tests-zkevm@v0.8.0](https://github.com/ethereum/execution-specs/releases/tag/tests-zkevm%40v0.8.0):
- Based on `tests-glamsterdam-devnet@v8.1.0`.
- Re-enables external `t8n` filling for stateless benchmark fixtures.
- Adds stateless-input tests for ordered blob versioned-hash validation.
- Aligns stateless payload and request types with EIP-7688 progressive SSZ.
- Exposes the full schema ID in stateless validation results and simplifies chain configuration.
- Preserves block `extraData` when constructing stateless artifacts.
- Uses progressive SSZ lists for witness state, codes, and public keys.

In the release description, each change has a link to the corresponding PR with a bit more info. Also, decided to skip v0.7.x minor version to align `tests-zkevm@` with the underlying versioning of `test-glamsterdam-devnet@` major version. (Not sure how versioning will continue in H*, but we can see at some point if makes sense to continue with this policy).
